{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted crew-neck knit top, long sleeves, hip length, red (#C8102E), soft merino-blend fabric
High-rise straight-leg jeans, full length to the ankle, dark indigo (#1F2A44), non-stretch denim with a slight structure
Single-breasted wool-blend coat, relaxed cut, knee length, camel (#B98B5E), brushed wool
Leather ankle boots, low block heel, almond toe, chocolate brown (#4A2C1D), smooth leather
Leather shoulder bag, medium size, structured, chocolate brown (#4A2C1D), smooth leather
Wide silk-blend scarf, loosely draped, warm cream (#EFE3CF), soft twill
Small gold hoop earrings, polished metal (#C9A24B)

This outfit puts the red top you asked for at the center, so it is the first thing people notice, while dark denim and camel keep everything else calm and relaxed for a meet-up with friends. The warm red and camel look rich against your deep skin tone and dark hair, and the cream scarf brightens the face. The straight jeans and the structured, easy coat give a neat, comfortable shape that suits an autumn day out. Brown boots and a matching bag tie the look together without competing with the red."}
